learnings: `str.isidentifier()` implements the real lexer rules; hand-rolled `isalnum()` checks accept `x²`.
Hard keywords are errors, soft keywords (`match`, `case`, `type`) are legal but confusing, built-ins can be shadowed.
Style depends on what the name is for: snake_case variables, CONSTANT_CASE constants, CapWords classes.
pitfalls: Lower-casing every suggestion wrongly told people to rename constants – suggestions are now kind-aware.
next: Run `ruff` with the `N` (pep8-naming) rules to enforce this automatically.
